comments.author: Standard
comments.text: You can take off your boxers or just leave them on. Just make sure it doesn’t go through to your pants.

comments.author: Simim
comments.text: It’s not a night-ruiner unless it smells. Just wipe off what you can in the bathroom, rinse off the stain a bit, pat dry with something, wash your hands, spray some cologne, and walk out like a pro. Anyone asks what took you so long, brag about the epic deuce you just dropped.
